steps.message: Statics often hide inside lambda bodies and LINQ chains, so I'll read `Services/ReportGenerator.cs` in full rather than rely on a shallow grep.

I scanned `LambdaStatics/` and paid special attention to statics hidden inside lambdas, LINQ chains and delegate lists — they are easy to miss but still make the code untestable. `ReportGenerator.cs` has 11 such call sites.

### Statics inside expression chains (Services/ReportGenerator.cs)

| File:line | Call | Where it hides |
|-----------|------|----------------|
| ReportGenerator.cs:8 | `File.Exists(path)` | inside `.Where(path => ...)` |
| ReportGenerator.cs:9 | `DateTime.UtcNow` + `File.ReadAllText(path)` | inside `.Select(path => ...)` |
| ReportGenerator.cs:17 | `File.WriteAllText` + `DateTime.Now` | inside an `Action` in a list initializer |
| ReportGenerator.cs:18 | `Console.WriteLine` + `DateTime.UtcNow` | inside an `Action` delegate |
| ReportGenerator.cs:19 | `Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable` + `DateTime.UtcNow` | inside an `Action` delegate |
| ReportGenerator.cs:27 | `Directory.GetFiles` | LINQ source |
| ReportGenerator.cs:28 | `new FileInfo(f).LastWriteTimeUtc` + `DateTime.UtcNow` | inside `.Where(f => ...)` — a hidden file-system dependency, not a static, but still untestable |
| ReportGenerator.cs:29 | `File.ReadAllText(f)` | inside `.Select(f => ...)` |
| ReportGenerator.cs:30 | `Environment.MachineName` | inside `.Where(content => ...)` |

### Category totals

- Time: 5 (`DateTime.UtcNow` ×4, `DateTime.Now` ×1)
- File System: 5 (`File.Exists`, `File.ReadAllText` ×2, `File.WriteAllText`, `Directory.GetFiles`, plus the `new FileInfo(...).LastWriteTimeUtc` hidden dependency)
- Environment: 2 (`Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable`, `Environment.MachineName`)
- Console: 1

None of these are behind an abstraction, so the whole class is currently impossible to unit-test deterministically. Inject `TimeProvider` and `IFileSystem`, and the lambda bodies become testable without touching real files or the wall clock.
